open_questions: Spindle spline tooth count (23..25) is not resolved by the scan: a tooth count or the mating knob would fix it.
The scan is an assembly (cap + body + microswitch + terminals); it is delivered as ONE fused solid as scanned. A multi-body STEP would be a separate job.
Interior (valve bore, spool, flow passages) was not scanned and is not modelled; the column is solid below the top port bore.
